1.title: Runs per hour
1.description: One server span named POST /invocations per run, service guppi_gpt.DEFAULT, exported by the instrumented container (observed in the tenant 5 Sep 2026).

2.title: Run duration p50/p90
2.description: Duration of the POST /invocations server span, which is the whole run rather than the first delta; the first delta lives only on the agent's log line in CloudWatch (runtime-logs), which Firehose does not forward.

3.title: Run outcome split
3.description: The failure flag on the POST /invocations server span. RUN_ERROR events emitted on a 200 stream are not failures here; the outcome field on the agent's CloudWatch log line is the finer source.

4.title: Retrieval rate
4.description: Share of runs (distinct trace ids with a POST /invocations span) whose trace also holds at least one mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve span. Counting spans rather than traces gave more than 100 percent, since one run can call the tool more than once.
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "guppi_gpt.DEFAULT" and (span.name == "POST /invocations" or span.name == "mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve")
| summarize runs = countDistinctExact(if(span.name == "POST /invocations", trace.id)), withRetrieval = countDistinctExact(if(span.name == "mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve", trace.id))
| fields pct = if(runs > 0, withRetrieval * 100.0 / runs, else: 0)

5.title: Token usage
5.description: The Strands model span (named chat <model id>) carries the GenAI semantic convention usage attributes; if the attribute names differ in this Strands version, inspect one chat span in Distributed Tracing and adjust.

6.title: Feedback up/down ratio
6.description: The business event guppigpt.reply-feedback, ingested through the EventBridge API destination the stack creates (docs/proposals/feedback.md). The RUM custom action this tile used to query was never stored by the tenant; the vote now arrives on the bizevents table with vote, run.id, and trace.id as top-level fields.

7.title: WAF allowed and blocked
7.description: The edge gateway's web ACL (a REGIONAL ACL associated with the AgentCore gateway) through the AWS connection's built-in WAFv2 service; keys are cloud.aws.wafv2.<Metric>.By.Region.Rule.WebACL with Rule ALL for the whole ACL and one series per rule. BlockedRequests exists only once something has been blocked, so the blocked line is absent until then (verified 7 Sep 2026).

8.title: Gateway 4xx
8.description: CloudWatch metric UserErrors from AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore, polled through the AWS connection's custom metric rows on the dimensions Resource, Operation, Protocol; the Dynatrace key is cloud.aws.bedrock_agentcore.UserErrors.By.Operation.Protocol.Resource (verified 7 Sep 2026). The loopback URL rejection happens at the gateway's load balancer and is not separately counted, so this tile shows all 4xx, split by gateway.
